page.notes: The woodcut initial "A" is decorative and joined to "rtitiones" as printed. Library stamp at right and show-through marks omitted. The Greek words in the second paragraph (διαίρεσις) are reproduced as best read; the first may be διαιρετικὴ. Line-end words "Artitiones" likely reads "Partitiones" with the initial P under the woodcut; left as read. Marginal mark "Alethas" at right edge is a printed or stamped mark and is uncertain.
